title: Cosmic Particle Swarm
description: An abstract digital composition featuring dense clusters of multicolored glowing circles and dots flowing across a deep black background. Thin golden lines and wisps of white smoke weave through the particle formations, creating organic, nebula-like structures that drift from the upper left toward the lower right.
prompt: Abstract digital artwork showing flowing swarms of multicolored glowing dots and circles against pure black, interwoven with delicate golden organic lines and translucent white smoke trails that form sweeping cosmic cloud formations, dense particle clusters creating depth and movement from top left to bottom right, ethereal and luminous particle art style.
